svg.title: Figure 2. Who buys off whose contract (contract counts)
svg.text: Figure 2. Who buys off whose contract (contract counts)
Vertical piggybacking 1,651 (57% of cooperative contracts); horizontal pooling 775 (27%); central purchasing 4,516 shown dotted.
Vertical down: locals on state/multi-state contracts
Vertical up: state on local co-op
contract vehicle (node size = total volume; line width = volume of each link)
Sources: WA, OR, Chicago, Cook County, Baton Rouge, West Hollywood and Austin contract ledgers; contracts naming a cooperative vehicle or another government's contract (a lower bound).

Federal links omitted (thin in these data): New York City → GSA schedules 17; Washington state agencies → GSA schedules 6; Oregon state agencies → GSA schedules 4; District of Columbia agencies → GSA schedules 4; Baton Rouge → GSA schedules 2.
